title: Canal & Carondelet Streets, New Orleans, 1934 stereo view
blurb: Original caption: "Looking up Carondelet St. across Canal St. showing some of New Orleans newer skyscrapers." 1934 stereo view, from on 100 block of Bourbon Street, looking upriver across Canal Street and up Carondelet. American Bank Building (200 Carondelet) dominates the center of the photo, with the Hibernia Bank Building to the right. Automobile, streetcar, and pedestrian traffic at the intersection of Canal & Carondelet.
cond: Rectified 2026. Halves registered to 0.18% vertical error and 0.04° of rotation. Depth measured gentle (1.05% of frame width); hung in the VR Parlor at full size.
